name: Jitsi Meet Detection Suite
summary: JWT authentication failures, refused moderator actions, recording and live streaming, outdated or misconfigured Prosody, and the health of Prosody, Jicofo, the videobridge and Jibri on self-hosted Jitsi Meet.
summary_zh: 自建 Jitsi Meet 的 JWT 驗證失敗、被拒絕的主持人操作、錄影與直播、過舊或設定有誤的 Prosody，以及 Prosody、Jicofo、videobridge 與 Jibri 的健康狀態。
notes: Jitsi Meet has no decoders or rules in Wazuh. This pack decodes Prosody (the XMPP server), Jicofo, the videobridge and Jibri (the recorder) in the three shapes a manager receives: a syslog or journald line with a program name, the components' own log files, and the docker json-file log that docker-jitsi-meet writes by default. One rule serves all three shapes.

JWT authentication, from Prosody's token module: an expired token is level 3 (a tab left open past the token lifetime), a connection without a token level 5 (the meeting was opened without going through the application that issues the tokens), a token that this server did not sign or that is malformed level 8, a token used for a room it was not issued for level 6, a verification key that cannot be loaded level 7. Eight failures in two minutes are level 10: forgery attempts, or a token issuer whose signing secret no longer matches Prosody's. The shorter line of jitsi-meet releases before about stable-9xxx, which ends right after the reason, is recognised since 1.2 (1.1 left those failures at level 5).

These Prosody lines carry no client address. On docker-jitsi-meet Prosody sees every client through the web container, so no rule here can tell one client from another, and no blocking is offered on them. The real address is only in the access log of the web server in front of Jitsi.

Refused actions are level 6: a participant without the right asking to record or live stream, to end the meeting for everyone, to manage breakout rooms, audio and video moderation or room metadata, or to dial out, a join with a crafted MUC resource, an address over Prosody's login or join rate limit. The web client does not offer these to such a participant, so they point to a modified client or the API. An attempt to kick or demote the meeting focus (Jicofo), which is how a participant would take a meeting over, and a forged visitor or recording metadata message are level 8 (logged by jitsi-meet 11248 and 11031); moderating or correcting other participants' chat messages without the right is level 5. Account or server administration through XMPP admin commands is level 8, an address put on Prosody's registration blocklist level 6.

A successful login is not an alert: every participant logs in once per connection and the components on every reconnect, so XMPP logins are recorded at level 2. An account with an administrative role (prosody:admin or prosody:operator, logged by Prosody 13) is level 3, except the components' built-in accounts focus, jvb, jibri and jigasi on the auth domain, which docker-jitsi-meet makes administrators. The login line carries no client address and no login failure names the account, so external sources and success after failures cannot be told apart. The pack needs no list.

Availability: a component that loses its XMPP connection is level 7, one that cannot reach the server for minutes level 10. Single reconnection attempts are recorded below the alert level, because a Jibri retries every few seconds (measured: 1,455 attempts in one hour of outage from one recording host). A lost videobridge is level 7, no operational videobridge level 10, a failed health check level 7 and repeated failures level 10, five participants failing ICE in ten minutes level 7, gateway errors from /http-bind, /xmpp-websocket or /colibri-ws level 5 and ten in two minutes level 10. A component that loses its XMPP connection three times in ten minutes is level 10: for Jicofo that is the symptom of the crafted-stanza denial of service fixed in JSA-2022-0002, JSA-2023-0002 and JSA-2025-0001 (measured on two recording hosts over 4.7 months: never three in ten minutes). Prosody, Jicofo or the videobridge starting three times in ten minutes is a crash loop, level 8; single starts are recorded below the alert level, and Jibri is left out because it restarts after every recording in single-use mode.

Recording: start and stop are level 3, a live stream level 5, a failed recording level 5, a Jibri that reports itself unhealthy or cannot write its recordings level 7. Without a finalize script Jibri logs SEVERE "Failed to run finalize script" after every recording (measured: 33 times in ten days on one host, once per recording); that case is recognised and recorded below the alert level. Jicofo's own report of a failed recording is level 5, for sites whose Jibri hosts have no agent. A live stream to a destination outside Jibri's RTMP allow-list is level 8 and a stream URL that is not rtmp or rtmps level 6 (a crafted request aimed at Jibri's ffmpeg); the allow-list is empty by default, see the setup guide. A participant kicked from a meeting is level 3, three kicked within five minutes level 7: usually a moderator clearing out intruders.

Prosody itself: a Prosody older than 13.0.5 or 0.12.6 starting is level 7, from the version in its start banner (CVE-2026-43504 to 43507: memory exhaustion by unauthenticated connections and relaying through mod_proxy65; the advisory also asks for libexpat 2.7.2, which the banner does not show; a distribution package that backports the fix keeps its old number). A module that fails to load is level 5, and level 8 when it is one that enforces something (token checks on joins, the lobby, the recording and dial-out filters, rate limits, bans, room passwords), because Prosody then runs without it. The unauthenticated telnet console and the SOCKS5 proxy being enabled are level 5 each, once per start. A connection over Prosody's per-address limit (13.0.5 and later, when max_connections_per_ip is set) is level 5, ten in two minutes level 10.

Deliberately not covered: guesses at a room password and lobby knocks (Prosody 13 and the Jitsi modules do not log them at info level), prosodyctl and the admin shell that replaced mod_admin_telnet (they write nothing to the log), the meeting portal's own audit log, a burst of joins to one room on an open instance (a large meeting at the top of the hour looks the same), and the TURN server (coturn serves other products too and belongs in a pack of its own).

The JWT is a credential, and it ends up in logs: Prosody's token_verification module writes the whole token into the line behind rule 132515, and the Jitsi client puts it in the URL of the page and of /http-bind and /xmpp-websocket. docker-jitsi-meet's web container redacts it in its access log; a web server in front of it does not unless told to (setup guide). Treat the alerts as sensitive. A token in the URL of /http-bind or /xmpp-websocket in that access log is level 5, at most once a day per manager node (rule 132582; the alert itself carries the token).
notes_zh: Wazuh 對 Jitsi Meet 沒有任何解碼器或規則。本套件解碼 Prosody（XMPP 伺服器）、Jicofo、videobridge 與 Jibri（錄影程式），涵蓋 manager 會收到的三種形式：帶程式名稱的 syslog 或 journald 行、各元件自己的記錄檔，以及 docker-jitsi-meet 預設寫出的 docker json-file 記錄。三種形式共用同一組規則。

JWT 驗證（Prosody 的 token 模組）：過期的 token 為 level 3（分頁開著超過 token 有效期），沒有 token 的連線為 level 5（沒有經過簽發 token 的應用程式就開啟會議），不是本伺服器簽發或格式錯誤的 token 為 level 8，token 用在不是簽發給它的會議室為 level 6，驗證金鑰無法載入為 level 7。兩分鐘內失敗八次為 level 10：有人在偽造 token，或簽發 token 的一方的簽章密鑰已和 Prosody 對不上。自 1.2 起也能辨識 stable-9xxx 左右之前的 jitsi-meet 較短的記錄行（原因後面沒有其他欄位；1.1 會讓這類失敗停在 level 5）。
這些 Prosody 記錄行不含用戶端位址。在 docker-jitsi-meet 中，Prosody 看到的每個用戶端都是 web 容器，因此這裡沒有任何規則能分辨用戶端，也不對它們提供封鎖。真正的位址只在 Jitsi 前端網頁伺服器的存取記錄裡。

被拒絕的操作為 level 6：沒有權限的與會者要求錄影或直播、要求替所有人結束會議、管理分組討論室、影音管理或會議室中繼資料、或撥出電話，用偽造的 MUC resource 加入，超過 Prosody 登入或加入的速率限制。網頁用戶端不會讓這類與會者看到這些功能，所以代表修改過的用戶端或直接呼叫 API。試圖踢出或降級會議的 focus（Jicofo，也就是奪取會議控制權的方法），以及偽造的旁聽者或錄影中繼資料訊息為 level 8（jitsi-meet 11248 與 11031 會記錄）；沒有權限卻要管理或修改別人的聊天訊息為 level 5。透過 XMPP 管理指令進行帳號或伺服器管理為 level 8，位址被列入 Prosody 的註冊封鎖清單為 level 6。

成功登入不是告警：每位與會者每次連線登入一次，各元件每次重新連線也會登入，因此 XMPP 登入記錄為 level 2。具管理角色的帳號（Prosody 13 會記錄 prosody:admin 或 prosody:operator）為 level 3，但各元件的內建帳號 focus、jvb、jibri、jigasi（auth 網域，docker-jitsi-meet 預設設為管理者）除外。登入記錄行沒有用戶端位址，登入失敗也不記錄帳號，因此無法分辨外部來源，也無法關聯「多次失敗後成功」。本套件不需要任何清單。

可用性：元件失去 XMPP 連線為 level 7，數分鐘都連不上伺服器為 level 10。單次重新連線記錄在告警等級之下，因為 Jibri 每隔幾秒就重試一次（實測：一台錄影主機在一小時的中斷中重試 1,455 次）。失去一台 videobridge 為 level 7，沒有可用的 videobridge 為 level 10，健康檢查失敗為 level 7、持續失敗為 level 10，十分鐘內五位與會者 ICE 失敗為 level 7，/http-bind、/xmpp-websocket 或 /colibri-ws 回應閘道錯誤為 level 5、兩分鐘內十次為 level 10。元件十分鐘內三次失去 XMPP 連線為 level 10：對 Jicofo 而言，這正是 JSA-2022-0002、JSA-2023-0002 與 JSA-2025-0001 修正的「特製 stanza 阻斷服務」的徵兆（兩台錄影主機 4.7 個月的實測：從未在十分鐘內出現三次）。Prosody、Jicofo 或 videobridge 十分鐘內啟動三次代表反覆當掉重啟，為 level 8；單次啟動記錄在告警等級之下，Jibri 刻意排除，因為單次使用模式下它每次錄影後都會重新啟動。

錄影：開始與結束為 level 3，直播為 level 5，錄影失敗為 level 5，Jibri 回報自己不健康或無法寫入錄影檔為 level 7。沒有設定 finalize 腳本時，Jibri 每次錄影結束都會記一行 SEVERE「Failed to run finalize script」（實測：一台主機十天 33 次，每次錄影一次）；這種情況會被辨識出來，記錄在告警等級之下。Jicofo 自己回報的錄影失敗為 level 5，供 Jibri 主機沒有 agent 的環境使用。直播到 Jibri RTMP 允許清單以外的目的地為 level 8，直播網址不是 rtmp 或 rtmps 為 level 6（針對 Jibri 的 ffmpeg 特製的請求）；允許清單預設允許全部，請見部署說明。與會者被踢出會議為 level 3，五分鐘內有三人被踢出為 level 7：通常是主持人在清除闖入者。

Prosody 本身：從啟動訊息中的版本判斷，啟動的 Prosody 早於 13.0.5 或 0.12.6 時為 level 7（CVE-2026-43504 至 43507：未驗證連線造成的記憶體耗盡，以及經由 mod_proxy65 轉送流量；公告也要求 libexpat 2.7.2，但啟動訊息不會顯示；以回補方式修正的發行版套件會保留舊版號）。模組載入失敗為 level 5；若是負責把關的模組（加入時的 token 檢查、大廳、錄影與撥出過濾、速率限制、封鎖、會議室密碼）則為 level 8，因為 Prosody 會在沒有它的情況下照常執行。啟用了不需驗證的 telnet 主控台或 SOCKS5 代理各為 level 5，每次啟動一次。超過 Prosody 每位址連線上限（13.0.5 起，需設定 max_connections_per_ip）的連線為 level 5，兩分鐘內十次為 level 10。
刻意不涵蓋：猜測會議室密碼與大廳敲門（Prosody 13 與 Jitsi 模組在 info 等級不記錄）、prosodyctl 與取代 mod_admin_telnet 的 admin shell（不寫任何記錄）、會議入口網站自己的稽核記錄、開放式站台上同一會議室的大量加入（整點開始的大型會議看起來一模一樣），以及 TURN 伺服器（coturn 也服務其他產品，應該自成一個套件）。

JWT 是憑證，而且會出現在記錄裡：Prosody 的 token_verification 模組會把整個 token 寫進規則 132515 對應的記錄行，Jitsi 用戶端也會把它放在頁面、/http-bind 與 /xmpp-websocket 的網址中。docker-jitsi-meet 的 web 容器會在存取記錄中遮蔽它；前面另外架的網頁伺服器則不會，除非另外設定（見部署說明）。請把這些告警當成敏感資料。存取記錄中 /http-bind 或 /xmpp-websocket 網址帶有 token 時為 level 5，每個 manager 節點每天最多一次（規則 132582；告警本身也帶有該 token）。
author: Jason Tools

agent_group.name: jitsi
agent_group.description: Jitsi Meet and Jibri hosts: the docker json-file logs of the containers and the access log of the web server in front

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset on every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並在所有節點重新載入規則集
setup.body: Install from this page, then use Reload Ruleset on the Rules tab. A cluster synchronises rule files but does not reload the workers.
setup.body_zh: 在本頁安裝後，到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集只同步規則檔、不會重載 worker。

setup.title: Put a Wazuh agent on the Jitsi server and on every Jibri host, in the jitsi group
setup.title_zh: 在 Jitsi 伺服器與每台 Jibri 主機安裝 Wazuh agent，並加入 jitsi 群組
setup.body: The group reads the docker json-file logs of the containers (docker-jitsi-meet's default logging driver, no change on the Jitsi side) and the host's nginx access log. Only lines written after the agent starts are read. A Jibri on a separate host needs the agent too: its recording and XMPP messages exist only there. The wildcard covers every container on the host, so on a host that also runs unrelated containers prefer the journald step below.
setup.body_zh: 群組會讀取各容器的 docker json-file 記錄（docker-jitsi-meet 預設的記錄驅動程式，Jitsi 端不需要任何變更）以及主機上 nginx 的存取記錄。只讀取 agent 啟動後寫入的新行。獨立主機上的 Jibri 也需要 agent：錄影與 XMPP 訊息只存在那台主機上。萬用字元涵蓋主機上所有容器，若主機上還跑著其他無關的容器，建議改用下一步的 journald 方式。
setup.verify: Start and stop a recording. Expect rules 132560 and 132563 (level 3) from the Jibri host.
setup.verify_zh: 開始並停止一次錄影，Jibri 主機應出現規則 132560 與 132563（level 3）。

setup.title: Or: send the containers to journald with a tag
setup.title_zh: 或者：讓容器以標籤寫入 journald
setup.body: With the journald logging driver each line carries a program name (the tag), so the lines are decoded as jt-jitsi and reach the agent through /var/log/syslog, which rsyslog fills from journald and the agent already reads. Add the logging section to docker-compose.override.yml for each service and run docker compose up -d. This recreates the containers: running meetings drop and recordings stop, so do it in a quiet hour. docker logs keeps working. Afterwards the containers write no json-file log and the json-file entry of the group finds nothing. On a host without rsyslog, add a journald localfile to the agent instead.
setup.body_zh: 使用 journald 記錄驅動程式時，每一行都帶有程式名稱（標籤），因此會以 jt-jitsi 解碼，並透過 /var/log/syslog 送到 agent（rsyslog 會從 journald 寫入該檔，agent 本來就有在讀）。在 docker-compose.override.yml 為每個服務加上 logging 區段，然後執行 docker compose up -d。這會重建容器：進行中的會議會斷線、錄影會停止，請在離峰時段進行。docker logs 仍可使用。之後容器不再寫 json-file 記錄，群組中的 json-file 項目就不會讀到東西。若主機沒有 rsyslog，請改在 agent 加上 journald 的 localfile。
setup.code:
services:
  prosody:
    logging:
      driver: journald
      options:
        tag: jitsi-prosody
  jicofo:
    logging:
      driver: journald
      options:
        tag: jitsi-jicofo
  jvb:
    logging:
      driver: journald
      options:
        tag: jitsi-jvb
  web:
    logging:
      driver: journald
      options:
        tag: jitsi-web
# on a Jibri host: the jibri service, tag jitsi-jibri

docker compose up -d
setup.verify: journalctl -t jitsi-prosody -n 5 shows Prosody lines, and grep jitsi- /var/log/syslog shows them too.
setup.verify_zh: journalctl -t jitsi-prosody -n 5 可看到 Prosody 的記錄，grep jitsi- /var/log/syslog 也看得到。

setup.title: Redact the token in the access log of the web server in front of Jitsi
setup.title_zh: 在 Jitsi 前端網頁伺服器的存取記錄中遮蔽 token
setup.body: The Jitsi client puts the JWT in the URL (?jwt= on the page, ?token= on /http-bind and /xmpp-websocket), so a web server in front of the docker web container logs every participant's token, and the agent ships those lines to the manager. Use the same redaction as docker-jitsi-meet's own nginx: define the two maps and a log format in the http block and use it on the Jitsi server block, then reload nginx (no interruption). This is a change on the monitored host.
setup.body_zh: Jitsi 用戶端會把 JWT 放在網址中（頁面的 ?jwt=、/http-bind 與 /xmpp-websocket 的 ?token=），所以 docker web 容器前面的網頁伺服器會記錄每位與會者的 token，而 agent 會把這些記錄行送到 manager。請採用與 docker-jitsi-meet 自己的 nginx 相同的遮蔽方式：在 http 區塊定義兩個 map 與一個記錄格式，並在 Jitsi 的 server 區塊使用它，然後重新載入 nginx（不會中斷服務）。這是受監控主機上的變更。
setup.verify: grep -c 'jwt=ey\|token=ey' /var/log/nginx/access.log stays at the count it had before the reload. Rule 132582 stops firing.
setup.verify_zh: 重新載入後，grep -c 'jwt=ey\|token=ey' /var/log/nginx/access.log 的數字不再增加。 規則 132582 也不再出現。

setup.title: Check the Prosody version and its libexpat
setup.title_zh: 確認 Prosody 版本與它使用的 libexpat
setup.body: Rule 132506 fires when Prosody starts with a version older than 13.0.5 or 0.12.6 (Prosody security advisory 2026-04-29: memory exhaustion by unauthenticated connections, unauthenticated relay through mod_proxy65). Full protection also needs LuaExpat linked against libexpat 2.7.2 or later, which only prosodyctl about shows. On docker-jitsi-meet, pull and recreate the prosody image (a short interruption of running meetings). Where Prosody's client or server port (5222, 5269) is reachable directly, the advisory also recommends limiting connections per address in the host firewall. A distribution package that backports the fix keeps its old version number: if its changelog lists the CVEs, the alert can be ignored for that host.
setup.body_zh: Prosody 以早於 13.0.5 或 0.12.6 的版本啟動時，規則 132506 會觸發（Prosody 2026-04-29 安全公告：未驗證連線造成的記憶體耗盡、經由 mod_proxy65 未驗證轉送）。完整防護還需要 LuaExpat 連結 libexpat 2.7.2 以上，這只有 prosodyctl about 看得到。docker-jitsi-meet 請拉取並重建 prosody 映像（進行中的會議會短暫中斷）。若 Prosody 的用戶端或伺服器連接埠（5222、5269）可被直接連線，公告也建議在主機防火牆限制每個位址的連線數。以回補方式修正的發行版套件會保留舊版號：若其變更記錄列有這些 CVE，該主機的這則告警可以忽略。
setup.code:
docker exec <prosody container> prosodyctl about | grep -i -E 'prosody|expat'
# Debian packages:
prosodyctl about | grep -i -E 'prosody|expat'
# directly exposed XMPP ports only:
ufw limit 5222
ufw limit 5269
setup.verify: Prosody 13.0.5 or later and libexpat 2.7.2 or later in the output; no rule 132506 after the next Prosody start.
setup.verify_zh: 輸出中 Prosody 為 13.0.5 以上、libexpat 為 2.7.2 以上；下次 Prosody 啟動後沒有規則 132506。

setup.title: Restrict where Jibri may live stream
setup.title_zh: 限制 Jibri 可以直播到哪裡
setup.body: Jibri's rtmp-allow-list allows every destination by default, so any moderator can send a meeting to any RTMP server. List the services the site uses; Jibri then refuses others and rule 132576 reports the attempt. On docker-jitsi-meet put the snippet in custom-jibri.conf in the Jibri config volume (copied in at start) and restart the jibri container: a recording in progress on that Jibri stops. On a Debian install add it to /etc/jitsi/jibri/jibri.conf and restart jibri. Patterns are Java regular expressions matched against the whole URL.
setup.body_zh: Jibri 的 rtmp-allow-list 預設允許所有目的地，因此任何主持人都能把會議送到任何 RTMP 伺服器。請列出本站使用的服務；之後 Jibri 會拒絕其他目的地，規則 132576 會回報這類嘗試。docker-jitsi-meet 請把下列片段放進 Jibri 設定磁碟區的 custom-jibri.conf（啟動時會複製進去），再重新啟動 jibri 容器：該 Jibri 上進行中的錄影會停止。Debian 安裝請加進 /etc/jitsi/jibri/jibri.conf 後重新啟動 jibri。樣式是比對完整網址的 Java 正規表示式。
setup.verify: A stream to an unlisted RTMP server is refused and rule 132576 fires on the Jibri host.
setup.verify_zh: 直播到未列出的 RTMP 伺服器會被拒絕，Jibri 主機出現規則 132576。

setup.title: Debian packages instead of docker
setup.title_zh: 使用 Debian 套件而非 docker 的安裝
setup.body: Add the Jicofo, videobridge and Jibri log files to the agent, and let Prosody log to syslog: its own log file starts with a timestamp that the Wazuh pre-decoder takes together with the next word, which breaks the line. Restart Prosody after the change (a short interruption of running meetings).
setup.body_zh: 把 Jicofo、videobridge 與 Jibri 的記錄檔加到 agent，並讓 Prosody 寫入 syslog：它自己的記錄檔開頭的時間戳記會被 Wazuh 的預解碼器連同下一個字一起取走，使整行無法解析。修改後需重新啟動 Prosody（進行中的會議會短暫中斷）。

active_response.title: Block an address that Prosody rate-limits for logins or joins
active_response.title_zh: 封鎖被 Prosody 以登入或加入速率限制的位址
active_response.body: Drops traffic from the address in rule 132525 on the Jitsi server, for 10 minutes. Only enable it when Prosody sees real client addresses: it needs PROSODY_ENABLE_RATE_LIMITS=1, PROSODY_TRUSTED_PROXIES listing the proxies, every proxy in front passing the client address on, and the Prosody lines arriving through journald or syslog (the journald setup step): in the docker json-file shape the address is not decoded and nothing is blocked. Until pack 1.2 the address of the "Limiting" line was never decoded either. On docker-jitsi-meet with default settings the address in the rule is the web container's or the host proxy's, and blocking it cuts every participant off. Check the srcip of past 132525 alerts first: if it is a 172.16.0.0/12 or 127.0.0.1 address, do not enable this. Other risks: everyone behind one NAT address (an office, a mobile carrier) is blocked together. Put the proxy, management and office addresses in the manager's white_list. The JWT failure rules are not offered for blocking, because their lines carry no address at all.
active_response.body_zh: 在 Jitsi 伺服器上封鎖規則 132525 中的位址 10 分鐘。只有在 Prosody 看得到真正的用戶端位址時才啟用：需要 PROSODY_ENABLE_RATE_LIMITS=1、PROSODY_TRUSTED_PROXIES 列出各層代理、前面每一層代理都把用戶端位址傳下去，而且 Prosody 的記錄是經由 journald 或 syslog 送來（journald 那一步部署說明）：docker json-file 形式不會解出位址，也就不會封鎖任何東西。套件 1.2 之前，「Limiting」那一行的位址也從未被解出。在預設設定的 docker-jitsi-meet 上，規則中的位址是 web 容器或主機代理的位址，封鎖它會讓所有與會者斷線。請先檢查過去 132525 告警的 srcip：若是 172.16.0.0/12 或 127.0.0.1 的位址，請不要啟用。其他風險：同一個 NAT 位址後的所有人（辦公室、行動網路業者）會一起被封鎖。請把代理、管理與辦公室位址加入 manager 的 white_list。JWT 失敗的規則不提供封鎖，因為那些記錄行根本沒有位址。
